players.product: 400G/800G/1.6T data center optical transceivers and 100G/200G PAM4 EML laser chips (via subsidiary Source Photonics)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (09-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: operating revenue RMB 27.798 billion, up 63.95% year on year, and net profit RMB 2.957 billion, up 290.09%. The company attributes the revenue growth primarily to new customers and new products in the optical transceiver business, in addition to the acquisitions of Source Photonics and GMD Group.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 27.798 billion (+63.95%); net profit RMB 2.957 billion (+290.09%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (09-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: the optical transceiver product line (Source Photonics) contributed RMB 5,350,999,299.05 of revenue, 19.25% of the total, at a 39.33% gross margin (no prior-year figure is shown). Electronic circuits (PCBs) remained the largest line at RMB 12,529,627,775.53 (45.07%). Overseas markets were 83.20% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: optical transceiver revenue RMB 5,350,999,299.05 (19.25%); gross margin 39.33%

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (09-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: through Source Photonics the company runs an IDM EML laser-chip line covering 2.5G to 200G. Its independently developed 100G PAM4 EML chips have been used in 400G and 800G optical transceivers by over ten million; 200G PAM4 EML chips have reached mass production to support 1.6T transceivers; 400G PAM4 EML chips under development are meant for 3.2T transceivers, alongside work on high-power CW light sources.
quarterly_data.figure: 100G PAM4 EML chips in over ten million 400G/800G modules; 200G PAM4 EML in mass production for 1.6T; 400G EML in development for 3.2T

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (09-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: data center transceiver line-up - 400G in QSFP-DD, QSFP112 and OSFP packages; 800G OSFP and QSFP-DD800 with DSP, LPO and LRO architectures; 1.6T with EML and InP PIC options in OSFP. The company is developing transceivers on two parallel routes, silicon photonics and its own EML, is promoting co-packaged optics, and is doing R&D on 3.2T and above.

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (09-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: amid a supply shortage of high-end EML optical chips, the company says Source Photonics - one of the few in China mass-producing 100G and 200G EML chips - has an advantage in capacity allocation and delivery, and is accelerating construction of EML chip and transceiver capacity. Construction in progress rose to RMB 4,514,260,841.57 from RMB 2,345,985,416.22 at the end of the previous year and net investing cash flow was RMB -5,482,528,738.38, both attributed mainly to capacity expansion for optical transceivers (including optical chips) and AI PCBs; the company says its expansion is matched to rising purchase demand from domestic and overseas mainstream cloud service providers.
quarterly_data.figure: construction in progress RMB 4,514,260,841.57 (from RMB 2,345,985,416.22); investing cash flow RMB -5,482,528,738.38

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (09-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: the company describes itself as a top 3 global PCB supplier, top 2 global FPC supplier and top 10 global optical transceiver supplier. Its AI PCBs (Multek high-layer-count and HDI boards on M8/9 ultra-low-loss materials) reach transmission rates of up to 224Gbps for GPUs, AI accelerator cards, AI servers and data center switches. Its top 5 customers make up a large share of sales.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 224Gbps; top 3 PCB, top 2 FPC, top 10 optical transceiver (company claim)
